about_the_game:
LEKANO WORLD ONLINE is a unique game where you battle, tame, and raise intelligent creatures—Lekamons—to forge your legendary team!

Battling and Taming
To acquire a Lekamon, you must face it in a dynamic third-person battle, controlling another Lekamon. Forget dull turn-based fights—you take full control of every attack, dodge, and tactic! After defeating it, you use the AXIS bracelet, which reverts the Lekamon to an egg state. Then, you hatch the egg, revealing a creature with a unique personality, set of stats, and three randomly assigned abilities from a predefined pool. Taming a Lekamon is a privilege earned through combat, not just tossing a random object and calling it your friend!

Storage and Management in the AXIS Bracelet
All your Lekamons are stored in the AXIS bracelet—your personal inventory and control hub. Here, you can view your full roster of tamed creatures, check their stats, and customize them for battle.

Raising and Utilizing
Once hatched, you nurture your Lekamons, tailoring their abilities and stats to create perfect combinations. They become your warriors in epic battles: challenge other players in duels, fight in arenas, or team up with friends to take down massive bosses. The monthly Olympics lets you showcase your collection and skill, competing for the title of Regional Hero in solo or 5v5 team battles.

A Living World and Uniqueness
Explore a vast island world brimming with mysteries and dangers. Lekamons are sentient beings with emotions and personalities, and their variety—from rare albinos to dark melanistic ones—makes each one special. Customize your hero and Lekamons to craft a unique style, and prove you’re worthy of becoming a legend.

LEKANO WORLD ONLINE isn’t just about collecting—it’s a test of your skill, where every Lekamon is a trophy won in battle and a loyal companion on your path to glory. Ready to fight for your team?
